note: なーんだ？ is the set closing phrase of Japanese children's riddles (nazonazo), so a Japanese reader hears at once that she is posing a riddle.
claim: Japanese riddles (nazonazo) conventionally end with the phrase なーんだ ("what is it?").

check.quote: 現代の日本では、最後の「何だ」という文句を「なーーんだ」と節をつけて歌うように語る事が多い。
